questions.question: What are the procedures for balancing an account?
questions.solution_html:
• Following is the procedure of balancing an account
  • i. Find out the total of debit side and total of credit side and identify the higher total.
  • ii. Ascertain the difference between total of debit side and total of credit side.
  • iii. If the debit total is more than credit total, put the difference on credit side as ‘By balance c/d’;
  • otherwise on debit side as To balance c/d.
  • iv. Close the account by writing total amount on both sides.
  • v. Put the debit balance on the debit side of the account and write ‘To Balance b/d’ otherwise on
  • credit side and write ‘By balance b/d’.
  • ( If the process is explained using imaginary figures too, award full marks)
  • Machinery A/c Dr 2,000
  • To Cash A/c 2,000

questions.question: What are the procedures for balancing an account? / State whether the balance of the following accounts should be placed in debit column or
questions.solution_html:
• Procedures for balancing an account
  • a. Total both debit and credit sides
  • b. Find the difference between both sides.
  • c. Enter the balancing figure: if the debit side > credit side, then write difference on credit side as ‘By
  • Balance c/d’. If the debit side < credit side, then write difference on debit side as ‘To Balance c/d’.
  • d. Tally the totals.
  • e. Bring down the balance as ‘To Balance b/d or By Balance b/d’.
questions.final_answer: Option Total both debit and credit sides

questions.question: What are the procedures for balancing an account?
questions.solution_html:
• Following is the procedure of balancing an account
  • i. Find out the total of debit side and total of credit side and identify the higher total.
  • ii. Ascertain the difference between total of debit side and total of credit side.
  • iii. If the debit total is more than credit total, put the difference on credit side as ‘By balance c/d’;
  • otherwise on debit side as To balance c/d.
  • iv. Close the account by writing total amount on both sides.
  • v. Put the debit balance on the debit side of the account and write ‘To Balance b/d’ otherwise on
  • credit side and write ‘By balance b/d’.
